app_act_desc_letters.ha: Haruffa. A nan za mu koyi haruffan Turanci.
app_act_desc_letters.en: Letters. Here we learn the English letters.

app_act_desc_quiz.ha: Nemo hoto. Za a faɗi sunan abu, sannan a danna hotonsa.
app_act_desc_quiz.en: Find the picture. The name of a thing will be said, then tap its picture.

app_act_desc_spell.ha: Rubutu. A nan za mu koyi rubuta kalmomin Turanci, harafi-harafi.
app_act_desc_spell.en: Writing. Here we learn to write English words, letter by letter.

app_act_pick.ha: Zaɓi darasi ɗaya, don jin ƙarin bayani a kansa.
app_act_pick.en: Pick a lesson, to hear more about it.

app_board_intro.ha: Ga dukkan haruffa. Mu koyi su rukuni-rukuni.
app_board_intro.en: Here are all the letters. Let's learn them group by group.

app_cat_desc_animals.ha: Dabbobi. Wannan darasi ne game da dabbobi iri-iri da suke rayuwa a kewayenmu.
app_cat_desc_animals.en: Animals. This lesson is about the different animals that live around us.

app_cat_desc_body.ha: Jiki. Wannan darasi ne game da sassa daban-daban na jikin mutum.
app_cat_desc_body.en: The body. This lesson is about the different parts of the human body.

app_cat_desc_food.ha: Abinci. Wannan darasi ne game da abinci iri-iri da muke ci a kullum.
app_cat_desc_food.en: Food. This lesson is about the different foods we eat every day.

app_cat_desc_home.ha: Kayan gida. Wannan darasi ne game da kayayyakin da ake amfani da su a gida.
app_cat_desc_home.en: Household things. This lesson is about the things used at home.

app_cat_desc_nature.ha: Yanayi. Wannan darasi ne game da abubuwan da ke cikin yanayi da muhalli.
app_cat_desc_nature.en: Nature. This lesson is about the things in nature and our surroundings.

app_cat_desc_vehicles.ha: Motoci. Wannan darasi ne game da motoci da abubuwan hawa daban-daban.
app_cat_desc_vehicles.en: Vehicles. This lesson is about cars and the different things we ride.

app_cat_start_animals.ha: Yanzu za mu ga hotunan dabbobi. Za mu koyi sunayensu da Turanci.
app_cat_start_animals.en: Now we'll see pictures of animals. We'll learn their names in English.

app_cat_start_body.ha: Yanzu za mu ga hotunan sassan jiki. Za mu koyi sunayensu da Turanci.
app_cat_start_body.en: Now we'll see pictures of body parts. We'll learn their names in English.

app_cat_start_food.ha: Yanzu za mu ga hotunan abinci. Za mu koyi sunayensu da Turanci.
app_cat_start_food.en: Now we'll see pictures of food. We'll learn their names in English.

app_cat_start_home.ha: Yanzu za mu ga hotunan kayan gida. Za mu koyi sunayensu da Turanci.
app_cat_start_home.en: Now we'll see pictures of household things. We'll learn their names in English.

app_cat_start_nature.ha: Yanzu za mu ga hotunan abubuwan yanayi. Za mu koyi sunayensu da Turanci.
app_cat_start_nature.en: Now we'll see pictures of things in nature. We'll learn their names in English.

app_cat_start_numbers.ha: Yanzu za mu koyi ƙirga. Za a nuna yatsun hannu. A ƙirga yatsun da aka ɗaga, sannan a faɗi lambar da Turanci.
app_cat_start_numbers.en: Now we'll learn to count. Fingers will be shown. Count the fingers that are up, then say the number in English.

app_cat_start_vehicles.ha: Yanzu za mu ga hotunan motoci. Za mu koyi sunayensu da Turanci.
app_cat_start_vehicles.en: Now we'll see pictures of vehicles. We'll learn their names in English.

app_quiz_tap.ha: Danna hoton abin da aka faɗa.
app_quiz_tap.en: Tap the picture of the thing that was named.

app_quiz_wrong.ha: A'a, ba wannan ba. A sa ke saurara, a sa ke gwadawa.
app_quiz_wrong.en: No, not that one. Listen again, try again.

app_read_good_f.en: Well done! Now you can read!

app_read_good.en: Well done! Now you can read!

app_read_intro.ha: Ga kalma. Za mu karanta wannan kalma tare. Harafi, harafi.
app_read_intro.en: Here is a word. We'll read this word together. Letter by letter.

app_read_word.ha: Yanzu, a karanta kalmar gaba ɗaya, da babbar murya.
app_read_word.en: Now read the whole word, out loud.

app_spell_intro.ha: Yanzu, ka rubuta shi da Turanci. Akwai hanyoyi biyu.
app_spell_intro.en: Now write it in English. There are two ways.

app_spell_intro_f.ha: Yanzu, ki rubuta shi da Turanci. Akwai hanyoyi biyu.
app_spell_intro_f.en: Now write it in English. There are two ways.

app_spell_ord_1.ha: Danna ko a faɗi harafi na farko.
app_spell_ord_1.en: Tap or say the first letter.

app_spell_ord_2.ha: Danna ko a faɗi harafi na biyu.
app_spell_ord_2.en: Tap or say the second letter.

app_spell_ord_3.ha: Danna ko a faɗi harafi na uku.
app_spell_ord_3.en: Tap or say the third letter.

app_spell_ord_4.ha: Danna ko a faɗi harafi na huɗu.
app_spell_ord_4.en: Tap or say the fourth letter.

app_spell_ord_5.ha: Danna ko a faɗi harafi na biyar.
app_spell_ord_5.en: Tap or say the fifth letter.

app_spell_ord_6.ha: Danna ko a faɗi harafi na shida.
app_spell_ord_6.en: Tap or say the sixth letter.

app_spell_ord_7.ha: Danna ko a faɗi harafi na bakwai.
app_spell_ord_7.en: Tap or say the seventh letter.

app_spell_ord_8.ha: Danna ko a faɗi harafi na takwas.
app_spell_ord_8.en: Tap or say the eighth letter.

app_spell_ord_9.ha: Danna ko a faɗi harafi na tara.
app_spell_ord_9.en: Tap or say the ninth letter.

app_spell_way_speak.ha: Ka danna Laila, ka faɗi harafin.
app_spell_way_speak.en: Press Laila and say the letter.

app_spell_way_speak_f.ha: Ki danna Laila, ki faɗi harafin.
app_spell_way_speak_f.en: Press Laila and say the letter.

app_spell_way_tap.ha: Ko kuma ka danna kowane harafi.

app_spell_way_tap_f.ha: Ko kuma ki danna kowane harafi.

app_stage_done.en: Well done! You've finished this group.

app_stage_done_f.en: Well done! You've finished this group.

app_w_menu_intro.ha: Ga darussa dabam-dabam. Danna kowane hoto don sanin abin da ke cikinsa.
app_w_menu_intro.en: Here are the different lessons. Tap any picture to find out what's in it.

app_w_spell_test.ha: Yanzu, jarrabawa! A rubuta kowanne, harafi-harafi.
app_w_spell_test.en: Now, a test! Write each one, letter by letter.

app_z_speak.ha: Duk lokacin da ake son yin magana, a danna kan Laila. Zan saurara da kyau!
app_z_speak.en: Whenever you want to speak, press Laila. I'll listen carefully!

s0.ha: Sannu! Idan ke mace ce, danna fari. Idan kai namiji ne, danna ja.
s0.en: Hello! If you are a girl, tap the white one. If you are a boy, tap the red one.

s_abc_say_m.ha: Ka danna kan Laila, sai ka faɗi harafin da ka gani.
s_abc_say_m.en: Press Laila, then say the letter you see.

s_abc_say_f.ha: Ki danna kan Laila, sai ki faɗi harafin da kin gani.
s_abc_say_f.en: Press Laila, then say the letter you see.

s_act_desc_things.ha: Abubuwa. A nan za mu koyi sunayen abubuwa da Turanci, da hotuna.
s_act_desc_things.en: Things. Here we learn the names of things in English, with pictures.

s_all_done_m.ha: Madalla! Yanzu kaa iya haruffa da kalmomi duka.
s_all_done_m.en: Well done! Now you know all the letters and words.

s_all_done_f.ha: Madalla! Yanzu kin iya haruffa da kalmomi duka.
s_all_done_f.en: Well done! Now you know all the letters and words.

s_alone2_m.ha: Akwai wani a kusa da kai. Don Allah, ka zauna kai kaɗai a gaban kyamara.
s_alone2_m.en: There is someone next to you. Please sit alone in front of the camera.

s_alone2_f.ha: Akwai wani a kusa da ke. Don Allah, ki zauna ke kaɗai a gaban kyamara.
s_alone2_f.en: There is someone next to you. Please sit alone in front of the camera.

s_back_m.ha: Don komawa baya, ka danna wannan ƙofa.

s_back_f.ha: Don komawa baya, ki danna wannan ƙofa.

s_cat_desc_actions.ha: Ayyuka. Wannan darasi ne game da abubuwan da muke yi a kullum. Kamar ci, sha, gudu da wasa.
s_cat_desc_actions.en: Actions. This lesson is about the things we do every day. Like eating, drinking, running and playing.

s_cat_desc_clothing.ha: Tufafi. Wannan darasi ne game da tufafin da muke sawa a jiki.
s_cat_desc_clothing.en: Clothing. This lesson is about the clothes we wear.

s_cat_desc_people.ha: Mutane. Wannan darasi ne game da mutanen da ke kewaye da mu. Mama, baba, yara da malamai.
s_cat_desc_people.en: People. This lesson is about the people around us. Mum, dad, children and teachers.

s_cat_desc_school.ha: Makaranta. Wannan darasi ne game da kayan makaranta da muke amfani da su.
s_cat_desc_school.en: School. This lesson is about the things we use at school.

s_cat_start_actions.ha: Yanzu za mu ga hotunan ayyuka. Za mu koyi sunayensu da Turanci.
s_cat_start_actions.en: Now we'll see pictures of actions. We'll learn their names in English.

s_cat_start_clothing.ha: Yanzu za mu ga hotunan tufafi. Za mu koyi sunayensu da Turanci.
s_cat_start_clothing.en: Now we'll see pictures of clothes. We'll learn their names in English.

s_cat_start_people.ha: Yanzu za mu ga hotunan mutane. Za mu koyi sunayensu da Turanci.
s_cat_start_people.en: Now we'll see pictures of people. We'll learn their names in English.

s_cat_start_school.ha: Yanzu za mu ga hotunan kayan makaranta. Za mu koyi sunayensu da Turanci.
s_cat_start_school.en: Now we'll see pictures of school things. We'll learn their names in English.

s_ear_m.ha: Don sa ke ji, ka danna wannan kunne.
s_ear_m.en: To hear it again, press this ear.

s_ear_f.ha: Don sa ke ji, ki danna wannan kunne.
s_ear_f.en: To hear it again, press this ear.

s_go_m.ha: Yanzu, ka danna kan Laila mu fara.
s_go_m.en: Now press Laila and we'll start.

s_go_f.ha: Yanzu, ki danna kan Laila mu fara.
s_go_f.en: Now press Laila and we'll start.

s_k_intro2.ha: Karatu. A nan za mu karanta kalmomi, harafi bayan harafi, sannan gaba ɗaya.
s_k_intro2.en: Reading. Here we read words, letter by letter, then all at once.

s_k_lesson.ha: Yanzu, za mu karanta sunayen waɗannan abubuwa da Turanci.
s_k_lesson.en: Now we'll read the names of these things in English.

s_k_test_m.ha: Yanzu za mu yi ƙaramin jarrabawa a kan kalmomin da kaa koyaa. Za a nuna maka kalma, sai ka karanta ta gaba ɗaya.
s_k_test_m.en: Now we'll do a small test on the words you learned. A word will be shown, and you read it whole.

s_k_test_f.ha: Yanzu za mu yi ƙaramin jarrabawa a kan kalmomin da kika koyaa. Za a nuna miki kalma, sai ki karanta ta gaba ɗaya.
s_k_test_f.en: Now we'll do a small test on the words you learned. A word will be shown, and you read it whole.

s_kd_k3.ha: Kalmomi gajeru. A nan za mu karanta kalmomi gajeru, masu haruffa uku.
s_kd_k3.en: Short words. Here we read short, three-letter words.

s_kd_k45.ha: Kalmomi matsakaita. A nan za mu karanta kalmomi masu haruffa huɗu da biyar.
s_kd_k45.en: Medium words. Here we read four- and five-letter words.

s_kd_klong.ha: Kalmomi dogaye. A nan za mu karanta kalmomi dogaye.
s_kd_klong.en: Long words. Here we read long words.

s_kd_knum.ha: Lambobi. A nan za mu karanta sunayen lambobi da Turanci.
s_kd_knum.en: Numbers. Here we read the names of numbers in English.

s_l_check_m.ha: Yanzu za mu yi ƙaramin jarrabawa, don mu tabbata kaa gane haruffan da kaa koyaa.
s_l_check_m.en: Now we'll do a small test, to make sure you understood the letters you learned.

s_l_check_f.ha: Yanzu za mu yi ƙaramin jarrabawa, don mu tabbata kin gane haruffan da kika koyaa.
s_l_check_f.en: Now we'll do a small test, to make sure you understood the letters you learned.

s_l_final1_m.ha: Babbar jarrabawa. Ka faɗi haruffa duka, ɗaya bayan ɗaya.
s_l_final1_m.en: The big test. Say all the letters, one after another.

s_l_final1_f.ha: Babbar jarrabawa. Ki faɗi haruffa duka, ɗaya bayan ɗaya.
s_l_final1_f.en: The big test. Say all the letters, one after another.

s_l_final2_m.ha: Jarrabawa ta ƙarshe. Za a nuna haruffa a gauraye, ka faɗe su duka.
s_l_final2_m.en: The last test. The letters will be shown mixed up; say them all.

s_l_final2_f.ha: Jarrabawa ta ƙarshe. Za a nuna haruffa a gauraye, ki faɗe su duka.
s_l_final2_f.en: The last test. The letters will be shown mixed up; say them all.

s_l_look_m.ha: Ga haruffa huɗu. Ka saurara, ka kalla.
s_l_look_m.en: Here are four letters. Listen and look.

s_l_look_f.ha: Ga haruffa huɗu. Ki saurara, ki kalla.
s_l_look_f.en: Here are four letters. Listen and look.

s_l_new2_m.ha: Yanzu za ka ga sababbin haruffa biyu don koyo. Wannan sabon mataki ne, mai muhimmanci ƙwarai.
s_l_new2_m.en: Now you'll see two new letters to learn. This is a new stage, a very important one.

s_l_new2_f.ha: Yanzu za ki ga sababbin haruffa biyu don koyo. Wannan sabon mataki ne, mai muhimmanci ƙwarai.
s_l_new2_f.en: Now you'll see two new letters to learn. This is a new stage, a very important one.

s_l_new4_m.ha: Yanzu za ka ga sababbin haruffa huɗu don koyo. Wannan sabon mataki ne, mai muhimmanci ƙwarai.
s_l_new4_m.en: Now you'll see four new letters to learn. This is a new stage, a very important one.

s_l_new4_f.ha: Yanzu za ki ga sababbin haruffa huɗu don koyo. Wannan sabon mataki ne, mai muhimmanci ƙwarai.
s_l_new4_f.en: Now you'll see four new letters to learn. This is a new stage, a very important one.

s_l_recall_m.ha: Yanzu, kai ka faɗi shi da kanka.

s_l_recall_f.ha: Yanzu, ke ki faɗi shi da kanki.

s_laila2_m.ha: Sunana Laila. Ni ce abokiyar koyonka. Yanzu, ka danna kaina mu fara.
s_laila2_m.en: My name is Laila. I'm your learning friend. Now press my head and we'll start.

s_laila2_f.ha: Sunana Laila. Ni ce abokiyar koyonki. Yanzu, ki danna kaina mu fara.
s_laila2_f.en: My name is Laila. I'm your learning friend. Now press my head and we'll start.

s_leave.ha: Za a ƙare zaman. Idan an gama, a danna Laila. In ba haka ba, a danna baƙin allo.
s_leave.en: The session will end. If you are done, press Laila. If not, press the black slate.

s_loading.ha: Don Allah a ɗan jira. Ana shirya komai.
s_loading.en: Please wait a little. Everything is getting ready.

s_n_big_m.en: Now the big test! We'll test all the numbers you learned, to make sure you know them. A number will be shown, its name said in Hausa, and you say its name in English. If you've forgotten its English name,

s_n_big_f.ha: Yanzu babbar jarrabawa! Za mu gwada dukkan lambobin da kika koyaa, don mu tabbata kin gane su. Za a nuna miki lamba, a faɗi sunanta da Hausa, sai ke ki faɗi sunanta da Turanci. Idan kin manta da sunanta da Turanci,
s_n_big_f.en: Now the big test! We'll test all the numbers you learned, to make sure you know them. A number will be shown, its name said in Hausa, and you say its name in English. If you've forgotten its English name,

s_n_focus5_m.ha: Yanzu za mu sa ke koyon waɗanda kaa sha wahala da su, tare da wasu kaɗan da kaa sani, don ƙarin maimaitawa.
s_n_focus5_m.en: Now we'll learn again the ones you struggled with, together with a few you know, for extra practice.

s_n_focus5_f.ha: Yanzu za mu sa ke koyon waɗanda kika sha wahala da su, tare da wasu kaɗan da kika sani, don ƙarin maimaitawa.
s_n_focus5_f.en: Now we'll learn again the ones you struggled with, together with a few you know, for extra practice.

s_n_hundreds.ha: Yanzu ɗaruruwa: ɗari biyu, ɗari uku, har ɗari tara, sannan dubu.
s_n_hundreds.en: Now the hundreds: two hundred, three hundred, up to nine hundred, then a thousand.

s_n_intro.ha: A nan za mu koyi lambobi. Da farko, za mu ƙirga da yatsun hannu, daga ɗaya har goma. Sannan mu koyi alamun lambobi.
s_n_intro.en: Here we learn numbers. First we count on our fingers, one to ten. Then we learn the number signs.

s_n_palms.ha: Ga hannu. A ƙirga yatsun da aka ɗaga.
s_n_palms.en: Here is a hand. Count the fingers that are up.

s_n_sym2.ha: Yanzu alamun lambobi daga goma sha ɗaya har ashirin.
s_n_sym2.en: Now the number signs from eleven to twenty.

s_n_symbols_m.ha: Yanzu za mu koyi alamun lambobin da kaa koyaa, daga ɗaya har goma.
s_n_symbols_m.en: Now we'll learn the signs of the numbers you learned, one to ten.

s_n_symbols_f.ha: Yanzu za mu koyi alamun lambobin da kika koyaa, daga ɗaya har goma.
s_n_symbols_f.en: Now we'll learn the signs of the numbers you learned, one to ten.

s_n_tens.ha: Yanzu za mu koyi manyan lambobi: talatin, arba'in, hamsin, har ɗari.
s_n_tens.en: Now we'll learn the big numbers: thirty, forty, fifty, up to a hundred.

s_o_again2_m.en: Listen again. In English, it is:

s_o_allright_m.ha: Kaa samu duka daidai! Yanzu za mu ci gaba.
s_o_allright_m.en: You got them all right! Now we go on.

s_o_allright_f.ha: Kin samu dukka daidai! Yanzu za mu ci gaba.
s_o_allright_f.en: You got them all right! Now we go on.

s_o_focus_m.ha: Hotunan da za ka gani yanzu, su ne waɗanda kaa sha wahala da su. Za mu sa ke koyon su.
s_o_focus_m.en: The pictures you'll see now are the ones you struggled with. We'll learn them again.

s_o_focus_f.ha: Hotunan da za ki gani yanzu, su ne waɗanda kika sha wahala da su. Za mu sa ke koyon su.
s_o_focus_f.en: The pictures you'll see now are the ones you struggled with. We'll learn them again.

s_o_focus.en: The pictures you'll see now are the ones you struggled with. We'll learn them again.

s_o_look_m.ha: Ga hotuna. Ka saurara, ka kalla.
s_o_look_m.en: Here are three pictures. Listen and look.

s_o_look_f.ha: Ga hotuna. Ki saurara, ki kalla.
s_o_look_f.en: Here are three pictures. Listen and look.

s_o_miss.ha: Wannan ba daidai ba ne. Mu ci gaba.
s_o_miss.en: That one wasn't right. Let's go on.

s_o_new3.en: Now here are five more pictures.

s_o_next.ha: Yanzu, mu ci gaba zuwa na gaba.

s_o_retake.ha: Akwai waɗanda ba daidai ba. Za mu sa ke koyan su, sannan mu sa ke jarrabawar.
s_o_retake.en: Some weren't right. We'll learn them again, then take the test again.

s_o_test2_f.en: Now we'll do a small test, to make sure you know them. A picture will be shown, its name said in Hausa, and you say its name in English. If you've forgotten its English name,

s_o_three.ha: Wannan yana da wuya. Yanzu, mu ci gaba zuwa na gaba.
s_o_three.en: That one is hard. Now, on to the next.

s_o_turn_m.ha: Yanzu kai. Ka danna Laila, ka faɗi sunansa da Turanci.
s_o_turn_m.en: Your turn. Press Laila and say its name in English.

s_o_turn_f.ha: Yanzu, ki danna Laila, ki faɗi sunansa da Turanci.
s_o_turn_f.en: Your turn. Press Laila and say its name in English.

s_o_wrong.ha: Waɗannan kuma, za mu sa ke koyan su:

s_p1_m.ha: Za mu ɗauki bidiyonka kana faɗin sunanka. Misali, idan sunanka Musa ne, ka ce: Sunana Musa.
s_p1_m.en: We will take a video of you saying your name. For example, if your name is Musa, say: Sunana Musa.

s_p1_f.ha: Za mu ɗauki bidiyonki kina faɗin sunanki. Misali, idan sunanki Aisha ne, ki ce: Sunana Aisha.
s_p1_f.en: We will take a video of you saying your name. For example, if your name is Musa, say: Sunana Musa.

s_p2.ha: Ga yaro Musa. Yana faɗin sunansa.
s_p2.en: Here is the boy Musa / the girl Aisha, saying the name.

s_p2_f.ha: Ga yarinya Aisha. Tana faɗin sunanta.
s_p2_f.en: Here is the boy Musa / the girl Aisha, saying the name.

s_p3_m.ha: Yanzu kai, ka faɗa mana sunanka. Ka danna kan Laila, sannan ka faɗa mana sunanka.
s_p3_m.en: Now you: press Laila, then say your name.

s_p3_f.ha: Yanzu ke, ki faɗa mana sunanki. Ki danna kan Laila, sannan ki faɗa mana sunanki.
s_p3_f.en: Now you: press Laila, then say your name.

s_perm.ha: Muna buƙatar kyamara da makirufo domin aiki. A danna 'Allow'.
s_perm.en: We need the camera and the microphone for this to work. Tap 'Allow'.

s_perm_no.ha: Ba a ba da izini ba. A sake gwadawa, a danna 'Allow'.
s_perm_no.en: Permission was not given. Try again and tap 'Allow'.

s_q_again_m.ha: Yanzu mu sa ke gwadawa, da sababbi. Ka saurara da kyau.
s_q_again_m.en: Now let's play again, with new ones. Listen carefully.

s_q_again_f.ha: Yanzu mu sa ke gwadawa, da sababbi. Ki saurara da kyau.
s_q_again_f.en: Now let's play again, with new ones. Listen carefully.

s_qd_q4_m.ha: Hotuna huɗu. Za a nuna maka hotuna huɗu, a faɗi sunan ɗaya da Turanci, sai ka danna shi.
s_qd_q4_m.en: Four pictures. You'll see four pictures, one will be named in English, and you tap it.

s_qd_q4_f.ha: Hotuna huɗu. Za a nuna miki hotuna huɗu, a faɗi sunan ɗaya da Turanci, sai ki danna shi.
s_qd_q4_f.en: Four pictures. You'll see four pictures, one will be named in English, and you tap it.

s_qd_qnum_m.ha: Lambobi. Za a faɗi lamba da Turanci, sai ka danna alamarta.
s_qd_qnum_m.en: Numbers. A number will be said in English, and you tap its sign.

s_qd_qnum_f.ha: Lambobi. Za a faɗi lamba da Turanci, sai ki danna alamarta.
s_qd_qnum_f.en: Numbers. A number will be said in English, and you tap its sign.

s_qn_tap.ha: Danna alamar lambar da aka faɗa.
s_qn_tap.en: Tap the sign of the number that was said.

s_r_intro2_m.ha: A nan za mu koyi rubuta sunayen abubuwa da Turanci, harafi-harafi. Za a nuna maka hoto, sai ka rubuta sunansa.
s_r_intro2_m.en: Here we learn to write the names of things in English, letter by letter. A picture will be shown, and you write its name.

s_r_intro2_f.ha: A nan za mu koyi rubuta sunayen abubuwa da Turanci, harafi-harafi. Za a nuna miki hoto, sai ki rubuta sunansa.
s_r_intro2_f.en: Here we learn to write the names of things in English, letter by letter. A picture will be shown, and you write its name.

s_rd_r3.ha: Haruffa uku. A nan za mu rubuta kalmomi masu haruffa uku, harafi-harafi.
s_rd_r3.en: Three letters. Here we write three-letter words, letter by letter.

s_rd_r4.ha: Haruffa huɗu. A nan za mu rubuta kalmomi masu haruffa huɗu, harafi-harafi.
s_rd_r4.en: Four letters. Here we write four-letter words, letter by letter.

s_rd_r5.ha: Haruffa biyar. A nan za mu rubuta kalmomi masu haruffa biyar, harafi-harafi.
s_rd_r5.en: Five letters. Here we write five-letter words, letter by letter.

s_rd_rlong.ha: Kalmomi dogaye. A nan za mu rubuta kalmomi dogaye, harafi-harafi.
s_rd_rlong.en: Long words. Here we write long words, letter by letter.

s_rd_rnum.ha: Lambobi. A nan za mu rubuta sunayen lambobi da Turanci, harafi-harafi.
s_rd_rnum.en: Numbers. Here we write the names of numbers in English, letter by letter.

s_retry_face_m.ha: Ba na ganin ka sosai. Don Allah, mu sake gwadawa.
s_retry_face_m.en: I can't see you well. Please, let's try again.

s_retry_face_f.ha: Ba na ganin ki sosai. Don Allah, mu sake gwadawa.
s_retry_face_f.en: I can't see you well. Please, let's try again.

s_retry_name_m.ha: Ban ji sunan ka sosai ba. Don Allah, mu sake gwadawa.
s_retry_name_m.en: I couldn't hear you say your name. Please, let's try again.

s_retry_name_f.ha: Ban ji sunan ki sosai ba. Don Allah, mu sake gwadawa.
s_retry_name_f.en: I couldn't hear you say your name. Please, let's try again.

s_retry_laila_m.ha: Ka danna kan Laila don sake gwadawa.

s_retry_laila_f.ha: Ki danna kan Laila don sake gwadawa.

s_retry_door_m.ha: Ko kuma ka danna wannan ƙofa don komawa farko.
s_retry_door_m.en: Or click this door to go back and start again.

s_retry_door_f.ha: Ko kuma ki danna wannan ƙofa don komawa farko.
s_retry_door_f.en: Or click this door to go back and start again.

sx_intro_m.ha: Misali! Ka kalla, ka saurara yadda ake yi.
sx_intro_m.en: Example! Watch and listen to how it's done.

sx_intro_f.ha: Misali! Ki kalla, ki saurara yadda ake yi.
sx_intro_f.en: Example! Watch and listen to how it's done.

sx_k_letters_m.ha: Ni zan karanta haruffan, ɗaya bayan ɗaya. Ka saurara.
sx_k_letters_m.en: I will read the letters, one by one. Listen.

sx_k_letters_f.ha: Ni zan karanta haruffan, ɗaya bayan ɗaya. Ki saurara.
sx_k_letters_f.en: I will read the letters, one by one. Listen.

s_w_name_m.ha: Sunana Laila. Ni ce abokiyar koyonka.
s_w_name_m.en: My name is Laila. I am your learning friend.

s_w_name_f.ha: Sunana Laila. Ni ce abokiyar koyonki.
s_w_name_f.en: My name is Laila. I am your learning friend.

s_w_together.en: Together we are going to learn English.

s_w_l1.en: We will learn the English alphabet.

s_w_l2.ha: Za mu koyi karatu da rubutu da Turanci.
s_w_l2.en: We will learn to read and write in English.

s_w_l4.ha: Za mu koyi sunayen abubuwa kamar dabbobi da abinci da Turanci.
s_w_l4.en: We will learn the names of things like animals and foods, in English.

s_w_more.ha: Da sauran abubuwa masu ban sha'awa da yawa.

s_w_talk_m.ha: Za ka iya magana da ni. Zan kasance tare da kai.
s_w_talk_m.en: You will be able to speak to me and I will be with you.

s_w_talk_f.ha: Za ki iya magana da ni. Zan kasance tare da ke.
s_w_talk_f.en: You will be able to speak to me and I will be with you.

s_b_glad_m.en: I am happy to see you.

s_b_glad_f.en: I am happy to see you.

s_b_cont.ha: Yanzu, mu ci gaba daga inda muka tsaya.
s_b_cont.en: Now let us continue from where we stopped.

sx_do_say_m.ha: Ga abin da za ka yi don ka faɗa da Turanci. Za ka danna Laila, sannan ka ce:
sx_do_say_m.en: Here is what you will do to say it in English. You will press Laila, then you will say:

sx_do_say_f.ha: Ga abin da za ki yi don ki faɗa da Turanci. Za ki danna Laila, sannan ki ce:
sx_do_say_f.en: Here is what you will do to say it in English. You will press Laila, then you will say:

sx_do_read_m.ha: Ga abin da za ka yi don ka karanta da Turanci. Za ka danna Laila, sannan ka karanta kalmar:
sx_do_read_m.en: Here is what you will do to read it in English. You will press Laila, then you will read the word:

sx_do_read_f.ha: Ga abin da za ki yi don ki karanta da Turanci. Za ki danna Laila, sannan ki karanta kalmar:
sx_do_read_f.en: Here is what you will do to read it in English. You will press Laila, then you will read the word:

sx_do_spell_m.ha: Ga abin da za ka yi don ka rubuta da Turanci. Za ka danna Laila, sannan ka faɗi haruffan:
sx_do_spell_m.en: Here is what you will do to write it in English. You will press Laila, then you will say the letters:

sx_do_spell_f.ha: Ga abin da za ki yi don ki rubuta da Turanci. Za ki danna Laila, sannan ki faɗi haruffan:
sx_do_spell_f.en: Here is what you will do to write it in English. You will press Laila, then you will say the letters:

sx_do_find_m.ha: Ga abin da za ka yi. Ka saurara, sannan ka danna hoton da aka faɗa.
sx_do_find_m.en: Here is what you will do. Listen, then press the picture that was named.

sx_do_find_f.ha: Ga abin da za ki yi. Ki saurara, sannan ki danna hoton da aka faɗa.
sx_do_find_f.en: Here is what you will do. Listen, then press the picture that was named.

sx_do_findnum_m.ha: Ga abin da za ka yi. Ka saurara, sannan ka danna alamar lambar da aka faɗa.
sx_do_findnum_m.en: Here is what you will do. Listen, then press the number that was named.

sx_do_findnum_f.ha: Ga abin da za ki yi. Ki saurara, sannan ki danna alamar lambar da aka faɗa.
sx_do_findnum_f.en: Here is what you will do. Listen, then press the number that was named.

s_q_start_m.ha: Yanzu, za a nuna maka hotuna huɗu. Ka saurara sunan da aka faɗa da Turanci, sannan ka danna shi.
s_q_start_m.en: Now you will be shown four pictures. Listen for the name said in English, then press it.

s_q_start_f.ha: Yanzu, za a nuna miki hotuna huɗu. Ki saurara sunan da aka faɗa da Turanci, sannan ki danna shi.
s_q_start_f.en: Now you will be shown four pictures. Listen for the name said in English, then press it.

s_qn_start_m.ha: Yanzu, za a nuna maka alamomi. Ka saurara lambar da aka faɗa da Turanci, sannan ka danna ta.
s_qn_start_m.en: Now you will be shown numbers. Listen for the one said in English, then press it.

s_qn_start_f.ha: Yanzu, za a nuna miki alamomi. Ki saurara lambar da aka faɗa da Turanci, sannan ki danna ta.
s_qn_start_f.en: Now you will be shown numbers. Listen for the one said in English, then press it.

sx_r_plan.ha: Za mu faɗi haruffan ɗaya bayan ɗaya. Akwai hanyoyi biyu.
sx_r_plan.en: We will say the letters one after another. There are two ways.

sx_r_v1.ha: Harafi na farko, zan faɗa da murya.
sx_r_v1.en: The first letter, I will say with my voice.

sx_r_v2.ha: Harafi na biyu ma, zan faɗa da murya.
sx_r_v2.en: The second letter too, I will say with my voice.

sx_r_kb.ha: Harafi na ƙarshe kuwa, zan danna shi a kan allo.
sx_r_kb.en: And the last letter, I will press it on the board.

s_pop_intro_m.ha: Ga balan-balan masu haruffa. Ka danna balan-balan da yatsanka, sai ya fashe.
s_pop_intro_m.en: Here are balloons with letters. Press a balloon with your finger and it bursts.

s_pop_intro_f.ha: Ga balan-balan masu haruffa. Ki danna balan-balan da yatsanki, sai ya fashe.
s_pop_intro_f.en: Here are balloons with letters. Press a balloon with your finger and it bursts.

s_pop_done.en: Well done, we've finished the game!

s_pop_demo_m.ha: Ga misali. Zan fasa na farko:
s_pop_demo_m.en: Here is an example. I'll pop the first one:

s_pop_demo_f.ha: Ga misali. Zan fasa na farko:
s_pop_demo_f.en: Here is an example. I'll pop the first one:

s_pop_task_m.ha: Ka nemo harafi na farko na Turanci, ka fasa shi. Sannan harafin bayan sa, bi da bi.
s_pop_task_m.en: Find the first letter of English and pop it. Then the letter after it, in order.

s_pop_task_f.ha: Ki nemo harafi na farko na Turanci, ki fasa shi. Sannan harafin bayan sa, bi da bi.
s_pop_task_f.en: Find the first letter of English and pop it. Then the letter after it, in order.
